mapper.select: select * from gif where status = 1 and random_number >= #{randomValue} order by random_number limit 1
select * from gif where status = 1 and random_number = (select MIN(random_number) from gif) limit 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gif ( user_id, random_number, title, description, file_url, file_size, width, height, duration, status, view_count, like_count, download_count ) VALUES ( #{userId}, RAND(), #{title}, #{description}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{width}, #{height}, #{duration}, #{status}, #{viewCount}, #{likeCount}, #{downloadCount} )
